Both tap and drag are supported.\n */\nimport { useState, useRef } from \"react\";\nimport { motion, AnimatePresence } from \"framer-motion\";\n\ninterface Tab {\n  label: string;\n  content: React.ReactNode;\n}\n\ninterface SwipeTabsProps {\n  tabs: Tab[];\n  /** Extra className on the tab bar wrapper */\n  className?: string;\n  /** Color of the active underline (Tailwind bg class). Defaults to bg-[#F59E0B] */\n  underlineClass?: string;\n}\n\nexport default function SwipeTabs({\n  tabs,\n  className = \"\",\n  underlineClass = \"bg-[#F59E0B]\",\n}: SwipeTabsProps) {\n  const [activeIdx, setActiveIdx] = useState(0);\n  const [direction, setDirection] = useState(0); // -1 = left, 1 = right\n  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);\n\n  const goTo = (idx: number) => {\n    if (idx === activeIdx || idx < 0 || idx >= tabs.length) return;\n    setDirection(idx > activeIdx ? 1 : -1);\n    setActiveIdx(idx);\n  };\n\n  const variants = {\n    enter: (d: number) => ({ x: d > 0 ? \"100%\" : \"-100%\", opacity: 1 }),\n    center: { x: 0, opacity: 1 },\n    exit: (d: number) => ({ x: d > 0 ? \"-100%\" : \"100%\", opacity: 1 }),\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <>\n      {/* Tab labels */}\n      <div className={`flex border-b border-gray-200 px-5 shrink-0 ${className}`}>\n        {tabs.map((tab, i) => (\n          <button\n            key={tab.label}\n            onClick={() => goTo(i)}\n            className={`pb-2 mr-6 text-sm font-semibold transition-colors relative ${\n              i === activeIdx ? \"text-gray-900\" : \"text-gray-400\"\n            }`}\n          >\n            {tab.label}\n            {i === activeIdx && (\n              <motion.div\n                layoutId=\"swipe-tab-indicator\"\n                className={`absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-[2px] ${underlineClass}`}\n                transition={{ type: \"spring\", stiffness: 500, damping: 35 }}\n              />\n            )}\n          </button>\n        ))}\n      </div>\n\n      {/* Tab content with swipe */}\n      <div ref={containerRef} className=\"flex-1 overflow-hidden relative\">\n        <AnimatePresence initial={false} custom={direction} mode=\"popLayout\">\n          <motion.div\n            key={activeIdx}\n            custom={direction}\n            variants={variants}\n            initial=\"enter\"\n            animate=\"center\"\n            exit=\"exit\"\n            transition={{ type: \"spring\", stiffness: 300, damping: 30 }}\n            drag=\"x\"\n            dragConstraints={{ left: 0, right: 0 }}\n            dragElastic={0.15}\n            onDragEnd={(_, info) => {\n              const threshold = 50;\n              if (info.offset.x < -threshold && activeIdx < tabs.length - 1) {\n                goTo(activeIdx + 1);\n              } else if (info.offset.x > threshold && activeIdx > 0) {\n                goTo(activeIdx - 1);\n              }\n            }}\n            className=\"absolute inset-0 overflow-y-auto\"\n          >\n            {tabs[activeIdx].content}\n          </motion.div>\n        </AnimatePresence>\n      </div>\n    </>\n  );\n}\n","Description":"Reusable SwipeTabs component that provides side-by-side slide transitions for tab content with both tap and drag/swipe support, plus an animated underline indicator.","Overwrite":true,"TargetFile":"/home/pixel/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/igot-karmayogi-pwa/src/components/SwipeTabs.tsx","toolAction":"Creating SwipeTabs","toolSummary":"Create SwipeTabs"}}]}

I have a reusable solution that does not conflict with the Framer motion drag.\n\n\n","tool_calls":[{"name":"write_to_file","args":{"CodeContent":"import { useRef, useEffect } from \"react\";\n\n/**\n * Hook to add mouse click-and-drag scrolling to an overflow-auto container.\n * This bridges the gap for desktop users trying to swipe natively.\n */\nexport function useDragScroll<T extends HTMLElement>() {\n  const ref = useRef<T>(null);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const ele = ref.current;\n    if (!ele) return;\n\n    let isDown = false;\n    let startX: number;\n    let scrollLeft: number;\n\n    const onMouseDown = (e: MouseEvent) => {\n      isDown = true;\n      ele.style.cursor = \"grabbing\";\n      startX = e.pageX - ele.offsetLeft;\n      scrollLeft = ele.scrollLeft;\n    };\n\n    const onMouseLeave = () => {\n      isDown = false;\n      ele.style.cursor = \"auto\";\n    };\n\n    const onMouseUp = () => {\n      isDown = false;\n      ele.style.cursor = \"auto\";\n    };\n\n    const onMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {\n      if (!isDown) return;\n      e.preventDefault();\n      const x = e.pageX - ele.offsetLeft;\n      const walk = (x - startX) * 2; // Scroll-fast\n      ele.scrollLeft = scrollLeft - walk;\n    };\n\n    ele.addEventListener(\"mousedown\", onMouseDown);\n    ele.addEventListener(\"mouseleave\", onMouseLeave);\n    window.addEventListener(\"mouseup\", onMouseUp);\n    ele.addEventListener(\"mousemove\", onMouseMove);\n\n    return () => {\n      ele.removeEventListener(\"mousedown\", onMouseDown);\n      ele.removeEventListener(\"mouseleave\", onMouseLeave);\n      window.removeEventListener(\"mouseup\", onMouseUp);\n      ele.removeEventListener(\"mousemove\", onMouseMove);\n    };\n  }, []);\n\n  return ref;\n}\n","Description":"Hook to enable mouse dragging on horizontal scroll containers","Overwrite":true,"TargetFile":"/home/pixel/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/igot-karmayogi-pwa/src/hooks/useDragScroll.ts","toolAction":"Create useDragScroll hook","toolSummary":"Create useDragScroll"}}]}

Model Knowledge\n\n### Architecture & Mechanics\n- **Framer Motion Drag Values:** Using percentage strings with `drag=\"x\"` causes chaotic behavior because Framer Motion tracks drag internally in pixels. When `x` updates by 100 pixels, mapping that directly to `-100%` causes the element to fly offscreen (100% of its own width). Switched to pixel-based dragging: measured `containerWidth` via `ResizeObserver`, animated using `-activeTabIndex * containerWidth`, and mapped the `BottomNav` indicator using `(-val / containerWidth) * 100 + \"%\"`.\n- **Nested Drag Interception:** Standard `drag=\"x\"` on children (e.g., `SwipeTabs`) intercepts the drag event from parents. Removed `drag=\"x\"` from inner tabs so the main navigation carousel works reliably across the screen.\n- **Desktop Horizontal Scrolling:** Standard `overflow-x-auto` does not support click-and-drag panning with a mouse on desktop. The `useDragScroll` hook intercepts `mousedown`/`mousemove` to adjust `scrollLeft`. To prevent this drag from triggering Framer Motion's parent swiper, `onPointerDownCapture={e => e.stopPropagation()}` was applied to the scrolling containers.\n\n## 5. Model Knowledge\n\n### Key Architecture Constraints\n- **Tailwind v3.4** (NOT v4) — ShadCN init required downgrade; CSS vars like `bg-popover` were NOT properly set, so components hardcode `bg-white`, `text-black` etc.\n- **ShadCN uses `@base-ui/react`** — NOT `@radix-ui/react`. Radio group and Select come from this package.\n- **Pixel-based swipe math** — The carousel uses `useMotionValue(0)` in pixels (not percentages). When tab index is `i`, x position is `-i * containerWidth`. The `dragConstraints` is `{ left: -width * (TABS.length - 1), right: 0 }`. This prevents the \"jumping through 4 screens\" bug that occurred when percentages were used.\n- **TAB_PAGES are pre-rendered** — All 4 nav pages (Dashboard, Explore, Search, MyLearning) are always mounted in the carousel. This is intentional for instant swipe feel.\n- **`onPointerDownCapture` pattern** — Horizontal scroll containers use this to prevent the outer Framer drag from intercepting mouse events. This is the correct fix; the previous `stopPropagation` without `Capture` didn't work on desktop.\n- **`isDragging` state flag** — Set to true on `onDragStart`, false on `onDragEnd`. The `useEffect` that snaps to current tab checks `!isDragging` to avoid fighting the user's drag.\n\n### Data Architecture (To Be Designed)\nThe next agent must design and implement:\n\n**Content DB (stays static, backend would be read-only):**\n```\ncourses → sections → lesson_items (videos/readings)\n                   → section_quiz (questions with correct answers)\nquizzes → questions → options\n```\n\n**User DB (changes with user actions, PostgreSQL-ready):**\n```\nuser_profiles → user_course_enrollments\nuser_section_progress (completed: bool, confidence_score: 0-100)\nuser_quiz_attempts (answers: json, score: int, timestamp)\n```\n\n### Previously Failed Approaches\n- Using CSS `x: \"-100%\"` percentage in carousel → jumped 400% because container is 4x wide\n- Using `dragConstraints={containerRef}` → constraints weren't respected correctly; switched to explicit pixel values\n- Spring animation for tab snap → caused springback/kickback; replaced with `tween` + `easeInOut`\n- Having BottomNav inside individual pages → caused it to fade with each navigation\n\n---\n\n## 5.
